objective: Increase relevance and social participation around an established product.
businessContext: A familiar package became a personalized social object.
strategy: Replace brand labels with popular names to prompt finding, gifting and sharing.
outcomes: The program expanded from Australia to many markets and became a repeatable brand platform.
whatWorked: The product itself carried the participatory idea.
The behavior was simple and observable.
whatFailed: Name coverage and cultural adaptation created inclusion constraints.
transferConditions: The product or experience can carry meaningful, scalable personalization.
nonTransferConditions: Do not infer that adding names alone creates demand without distribution and cultural fit.
